text:
Ana: Quick sync 1: refapp mini tutorial launch next week. Need: landing + form, benchmark writeup (short), 30m webinar, and code snippet for the refapp README. Who can own which piece?

Mike: Ill take landing + tracking. Will wire UTMs -> HubSpot and set form redirect to the webinar page.

Ravi: Ill draft the benchmark narrative. Aim for a 250-300 word story with 3 visuals: latency vs tokens, cost per 1k tokens, and a quality-vs-quant curve. Need sample workload and model run outputs by EOD.

Jasper: I can surface the refapp sample from the dev sprint. Link (draft): https://redwood.local/refapp/mini-demo. It has the streaming + cache flows used in the tutorial.

Pilar: Messaging tip: headline should emphasize outcome not numbers. Try: "Ship predictable LLM features with lower latency and cost." Use the concrete stat as a subhead.

Ana: Good. Mike, set form hidden field utm_campaign=refapp_mini1 and tag leads for routing to community-sdr. commops-bot, confirm the HubSpot webhook name and any missing fields.

commops-bot: HubSpot webhook: hs_webhook_mini_refapp. Required property: source_campaign = "refapp_mini1". Funnels: community-sdr@redwood.ai.

Mike: HubSpot config done. Autoresponder will send calendar invite + link to the mini refapp repo. Also adding a thank-you download link for the benchmark PDF.

Ravi: Draft bench posted in docs PR: includes a conservative claim: "up to 2x lower per-token cost in typical batch scenarios" with notes on when this applies (seq length, batch size).

Ana: Webinar format: 30 min total 1: 15m hands-on tutorial, 10m benchmark narrative, 5m live Q&A. Target: engineers evaluating infra economics.

Jasper: Ill update refapp README with a code snippet showing the exact SDK call for streaming + caching and add a short 3-min screencap. Will link it from the landing page.

Pilar: For promo assets: newsletter subject = "Ship predictable LLM features with lower latency". Paid copy: "Mini tutorial: deploy a refapp and cut inference costs". Keep copy benefit-first.

Mike: Timeline check: landing & form by Wed EOD, bench doc Wed EOD, webinar Tues next week, promo starts Thu. Ill post live preview in the channel when the page is up.

Ravi: One more: include a short appendix in the bench with the exact commands used to generate the plots and the model config (quantization level, batch settings).

Ana: Perfect. commops-bot, create a tracking tag and set conversion goal to webinar_reg_complete.

commops-bot: Tracking tag created: refapp_mini1_v1. Conversion goal set to "webinar_reg_complete". :white_check_mark:

Mike: Added UTM test and verified HubSpot mapping. Will share the landing URL shortly.

Jasper: Uploading screencap now.

Ana: Thanks team 1: this looks on track. We'll run a final messaging review on Thursday morning.
